lines.9: 「I hear that arm is finally all better. Congratulations.」
lines.11: 「What? Getting fancy with my name because you want to borrow a new dating sim to celebrate your right arm healing?」
lines.15: 「I fell in love with Kinu... and I thought the relationship would just keep going from there.」

lines.19: 「There really is no limit to how much you can love someone.」
lines.20: 「Her innocence is so precious to me.」
lines.21: 「There's no limit to how much somebody can piss you off either.」
lines.22: 「It seriously gets on my nerves when a friend gets a girlfriend.」
lines.23: 「Replacing the word 'idiot' with 'innocent' is proof you're terminal.」
lines.25: 「You're about ready for a straight red.」

lines.27: 「And not only that. I want to kiss her too...」
lines.29: 「I do! I'm turning into half of a lovey-dovey idiot couple!」
lines.30: 「The very kind of god-awful thing I spent every day despising!」
lines.31: 「I can't make fun of those people anymore!」
lines.34: 「I don't know what to do with a problem that luxurious.」

lines.62: 「For a moment, I doubted my own eyes.」
lines.63: 「The man in that room was once known as Leo Tsushima.」
lines.64: 「Genus Coward, family Cynic, scientific name Not-Swept-Away-By-Emotion... reduced to his lowest form.」
lines.65: 「He was always weak under pressure, but he used to be a good guy.」
lines.66: 「I am glad his injury healed, but I never expected him to contract a disease next.」
lines.67: 「They say lovesickness is a nasty one.」
lines.68: 「The result of Kanisawa's devoted nursing, I take it.」
